gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the two sub-$150 picks (Amazfit Active 2 and Bip 6) are left off every list for the two HYROX Race fixes Amazfit is rolling out: live indoor pace from a Stryd footpod and automatic run-to-station transitions. HYROX runs are indoors, where Amazfit itself says GPS pace 'is not reliable on any watch', so on these watches the race mode is a timer you advance by button, not a pace tool.
standout_why: Compared against roxskin.io/guides/best-watches-for-hyrox (cited in one chat) and our own dealectric page (cited in all three). Roxskin already says HYROX is indoors where GPS is weak, suggests a footpod such as Stryd, and its table lists Active 2 transitions as manual. ChatGPT's third answer also warns that indoor GPS distance can be wrong. None of them says that the Active 2 and Bip 6 are missing from Amazfit's Stryd lists and its auto-transition rollout, or that the5krunner reports no updates after September for these two watches. None says that the COROS PACE 3 already has auto-transition plus Stryd pairing in Hybrid Fitness. Our page has no indoor-GPS or transition column at all.
decides: It supports the Amazfit Active 2 / Bip 6 pick for race-day splits, but only as a button-advanced timer. Their indoor run pace will be unreliable, and no announced update fixes that. A shopper who wants accurate pace on the 1 km indoor runs or hands-free transitions needs the COROS PACE 3 (Hybrid Fitness with auto-transition and Stryd pairing). It is $199 at COROS today, above the $150 budget, and Stryd costs extra. So the page should frame the under-$150 answer as 'Amazfit for race-mode convenience, judge runs by lap time, not pace'.

findings.label: Why GPS pace fails at HYROX (maker's words)
findings.value: Indoors 'satellite signals are limited or unavailable, so real time GPS pace is not reliable on any watch'; Stryd measures pace 'directly from your movement, not from satellites'
findings.source_title: Real Indoor Pace for HYROX Is Here (Amazfit US blog)
findings.note: The post shows no date of its own. It also says real-time indoor pace in HYROX Race mode 'is now live on T-Rex 3 Pro and T-Rex 3' and that 'Support for additional Amazfit devices will follow'. It does not name the Active 2 or Bip 6.

findings.label: HYROX run laps are indoors
findings.value: 'The eight 1km run laps in HYROX are run indoors, which means GPS is unavailable. The pace shown on any GPS watch will be wrong, potentially very wrong.'
findings.note: Published 24 May 2026, modified 28 October 2026. It names a Stryd footpod as 'the most accurate solution' and gives no figure for wrist-based indoor error.

findings.label: Stryd indoor pace accuracy (the5krunner)
findings.source_title: Amazfit + Stryd: Tested. Accurate Pacing for HYROX Racing Indoors (the5krunner)
findings.note: the5krunner states 'Expect accuracy of 99.5%' as an expected figure and shows no test data. I worked out 0.5% of 1,000 m = 5 m. The article lists Stryd in HYROX Race mode only for T-Rex 3 and T-Rex 3 Pro on firmware 4.3.8.2 or later, and it does not mention the Active 2 or Bip 6.

findings.label: HYROX auto-transition and Stryd on the update roadmap
findings.value: Not listed for either. the5krunner: 'Owners of Active 2 and Bip 6 get swimming improvements' in September, 'then nothing'
findings.source_title: Full Amazfit HYROX roadmap and watch updates to Q1 2027 (the5krunner, 23 Sep 2026)
findings.note: Auto-transition order: flagships (Balance 3, Cheetah 2 Pro/Ultra, T-Rex 3 range) in October, Balance 2, Balance XT and Active Max in November, Bip Max in December. The FAQ lists Stryd indoor pace only for Cheetah 2 Pro, Cheetah 2 Ultra, T-Rex 3 and Active Max. 'No auto-transition' is inferred from the Active 2 being left off these lists.

findings.label: HYROX auto-transition and Stryd on the update roadmap
findings.value: Not listed for either; September swim and sync updates 'then nothing'
findings.source_title: Full Amazfit HYROX roadmap and watch updates to Q1 2027 (the5krunner, 23 Sep 2026)
findings.note: The same roadmap as the Active 2 finding. Transitions stay manual by inference, and the Bip 6 does not appear in any Stryd list.

findings.label: How indoor (treadmill) distance is corrected
findings.value: After a treadmill workout a 'Distance calibration' screen lets you enter the real distance. For runs over 0.50 km the watch records a calibration value 'based on a built-in algorithm'.
findings.source_title: What should I do if the treadmill distance record is inaccurate? (Amazfit Bip 6 support)
findings.note: This covers the Treadmill mode. The page does not say whether HYROX Race mode uses the same calibration, and it does not name the sensor.

findings.label: Hybrid Fitness (HYROX) race mode and transitions
findings.value: Supported on PACE 3. In Race mode the watch 'will automatically detect' when a run or station is done and moves to the next phase. Manual Transition uses the Back/Lap button.
findings.note: Supported models: PACE 3, PACE 4, PACE 4 Pro, PACE Pro, NOMAD, APEX 2/2 Pro, APEX 4, VERTIX 2, VERTIX 2S. Choosing half-length races helps the algorithm detect transitions. The page does not name the detection sensor.

findings.label: Stryd in Hybrid Fitness, and button presses in manual mode
findings.value: 'COROS pairs with a Stryd footpod in Hybrid Fitness mode'. Manual mode takes 15 presses per full HYROX race.
findings.source_title: COROS Spring 2026 Update: Hill Alerts (ClimbPro), Pace Strategy (PacePro) and Hybrid Fitness (Hyrox) Tested (the5krunner, 31 Mar 2026)
findings.note: Same article: 'the runs are always indoors and GPS-based distance will be woefully inaccurate'. The compatibility table marks Hybrid Fitness 'Yes' for PACE 3.

findings.label: Price, COROS US store
findings.note: $49 over the $150 budget, before a Stryd footpod.
